clusters.mechanism: The orphan fallback claims any hidden process born during the invocation whose cwd is under a recorded directory, with no marker or ancestry evidence, so shutdown kills unrelated processes.

Discovery starts only at shutdown, so a detached descendant that has lost its parent chain, has no marker, and has a cwd outside the recorded roots is missed and survives while shutdown reports success.
A detached orphan with a visible, non-empty replacement environment and no marker is excluded by the hidden-process fallback, so it survives shutdown.
